joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.admission: Original native admission/cap256; bypass only within contiguous already-PREEMPTED prefix with identical priority; no new request crossed.
fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: native in every arm; original completion boundary retained
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: All original STORE/LOAD prepare, submission, completion and release paths unchanged.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.observations: Both modes evaluate and record the same online qualifications throughout the run, including after the action budget is exhausted, plus inherited native source/allocation/transfer/request observers. No CUDA query or synchronization added.
fixed.arrival_sequence: Same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals; every request completes1024 output tokens ignoring EOS.
fixed.B_LOAD_ORDER: native, no LOAD ordering adapter installed
fixed.B_RECOVERY_REPEAT: once or repeat8 per predeclared sequence; action budgets 1 and 8

selection: At each eligible native waiting decision, choose the oldest conservative-fit successor in the uninterrupted same-priority PREEMPTED prefix behind a full-history-capacity-blocked PREEMPTED head. Legality is checked online by the same predicate in both modes. At most one actual bypass per request/preemption episode; the run-wide action budget is the only changed factor: 1 versus 8. No request-ID or time threshold.
scope: One bounded action-budget development probe, once/repeat8/repeat8/once ABBA, normal capacity and fixed1024. Generic first-fit/backfill is a simple baseline, not a novelty or independent-confirmation claim.

deployment.comparison_scope: All four arms rerun with identical light observation on same GPU; completed observation is not a performance control.

hypothesis_source: recovery_fit/session-fixed-20261008-r02: once-action net flow differences +0.435%/-0.307%, with earlier local next output followed by re-preemption. Existing r01 traces contain 33 later physical-fitting head failures per arm; these are diagnostic opportunities only and legality must be checked online. This group tests whether a bounded repeat budget changes complete-service value.
stop_rule: Run this one four-cell group only. Keep all requests, arrivals, failures, unfinished requests and raw runs. Verify actual online queue changes separately from shadow suggestions and subsequent native allocation/LOAD/schedule/output. Report both paired complete-service effects and harmed requests. No threshold scan, tuning or automatic further same-load repetitions.
storage_note: Native data disk nearly full; this new session and its independent empty caches live on /tmp filesystem. Model/source remain original read-only locations. No past raw removed.
authorization: User: 允许超出“仅任务排序”的边界

intervention.once: Use the shared repeat_fit policy with one actual queue bypass available during the run; continue identical qualification observation beyond the budget.
intervention.repeat8: Use the same policy with at most eight actual queue bypasses during the run; continue identical qualification observation beyond the budget.
intervention.shared: At a legal decision move the oldest eligible same-priority already-PREEMPTED successor to the front, preserving the relative order of all others. Never cross a new request. At most one actual bypass per request/preemption episode. Retain original native peek/lookup/allocation/LOAD/STORE/schedule and all other policy paths; no protection, reservation, pin, priority, victim, admission-rule, quantum, stream, concurrency or budget change.

correctness_scope: Reuse the frozen native/fixed runner and original queue operations. Check only the new mode/installation boundary and bounded online action/episode accounting; native_paths checks the shared policy. Unchanged transfer and resource paths are not reimplemented.
source_basis: Frozen recovery_fit runner shape over source_handoff native/fixed execution; repeat_fit is installed only at the existing post-warmup scheduler adapter boundary. No early pin/full tail/LOAD order/completion shift.
primary_readout: Both AB and BA run-level differences for all-request TTFT, flow, maximum generation gap, unchanged joint SLO goodput, throughput/drain and actual copy/output work; each actual queue action versus shadow suggestion, candidate and bypassed head native allocation/LOAD/schedule/next output, re-preemption and per-request gains/losses. No same-state cross-run claim.
